description: Review L1-2 on a real player path: the T2 tutorial's nudge step gates Confirm (TutorialManager allow: [] - the lesson data says 'Gating DEPLOY_UNIT keeps the session open until both boxes are ticked'). Boots the lesson exactly like tut_t2_musterin (formations, roll-off, rotate and drop the Battlewagon), then clicks the real Confirm button DURING the nudge step. The phase refuses the DEPLOY_UNIT (tutorial gate); the DeploymentController now keeps the placement session open: the lesson's own hint toast is shown (not doubled by a 'Deployment refused' toast), the wagon is still a preview in hand (DEPLOYING, no position, no permanent token), Confirm and the unit card stay up, the step stays nudge_wagon. Before the fix the refused Confirm finalized the preview into a permanent token and cleared the session: the wagon was stranded (gone from the list, never deployed) and the nudge checklist could never tick. The scenario then nudges the wagon (Shift+click lift, click drop), the step advances, Confirm deploys it with exactly one board token.

steps.comment: the card must name WHAT the dropdown does (attach da Warboss to da Boyz) and WHY (they fight as one unit), not only how to reach the control. The predicate is deliberately the goal PHRASE, not the word 'attach' - the old copy said 'under LEADER ATTACHMENTS, set da dropdown to Boyz', which contains 'attach' while never telling the player what they are declaring.
OptionButton popup menus are native Windows - select+emit is the dropdown escape hatch
the Formations panel is a modal embedded Window - synthetic root-viewport clicks cannot reach its controls; setting button_pressed emits toggled exactly like a click
tie tolerance: press the roll button if still up, else the A DEAD HEAT re-roll button; no-op when neither exists

The roll-off winner depends on the dice: when the AI wins it deploys second and the human clicks Continue; when the human wins they pick 'Deploy first (Defender)'. Either way the human deploys first, which is the order the rest of the lesson drives.
park the pointer where the wagon will go so the ghost renders on the board - the rotation has to be VISIBLE in the screenshots below, not just readable off the controller

steps.script:
var dc = tree.root.get_node("Main").deployment_controller
if dc.ghost_sprite == null:
	return "NO_GHOST"
return abs(wrapf(dc.ghost_sprite.get_base_rotation() - BoardState.get_default_facing_for_player(1), -PI, PI)) < 0.001
steps.comment: the wagon ghost starts at the default enemy-facing, so the rotate step cannot be already-done on entry
picking the wagon up is NOT enough - the step still waits for a real turn
Confirm is gated until the wagon is turned - otherwise a player could deploy it flat and strand the step with no ghost left to rotate
rotate_right = +15 degrees a tap, so six taps is a quarter turn

steps.script:
var dc = tree.root.get_node("Main").deployment_controller
var want = BoardState.get_default_facing_for_player(1) + PI / 2.0
return abs(wrapf(dc.ghost_sprite.get_base_rotation() - want, -PI, PI)) < 0.02

steps.comment: turning the ghost is what advances the step
placing the wagon now advances to the nudge step, not straight to Confirm
the player hits Confirm during the nudge step, which the lesson gates (allow: [] - 'reposition the wagon first, then you can Confirm')

steps.equals: hint=true dup_toast=false step=nudge_wagon placing=true unit=U_BATTLEWAGON_T staged=1/1 previews=1 finalized=0 status=1 pos0=<null> confirm=true card=true
steps.comment: L1-2: the refused Confirm leaves the placement session open - the lesson's own hint toast is up (and not doubled by a 'Deployment refused' toast), the wagon is still a preview in hand (status DEPLOYING owned by the session, no position written, no permanent token), Confirm and the unit card are still shown, the step is still nudge_wagon. Before the fix the previews were finalized and the session cleared: the wagon stranded and the checklist could never tick
shift+click the placed wagon to pick it back up - the gesture this step teaches
drop 1.5in sideways: the wagon was turned 90deg so its long axis is horizontal, and the zone's y<=12in step sits just below

steps.script:
var m = GameState.get_unit("U_BATTLEWAGON_T").models[0]
var want = BoardState.get_default_facing_for_player(1) + PI / 2.0
return abs(wrapf(float(m.get("rotation", 0.0)) - want, -PI, PI)) < 0.02
steps.comment: the turn the tutorial taught actually lands on the deployed wagon, not just on the ghost
after the nudge the gated Confirm goes through: the wagon is DEPLOYED with exactly one board token
